correctness.rationale: Independent equivariant filtration proof: let Y consist of the cone with apex F on the join of the n middle-edge choices {B_i,C_i}, together with all matchings with exactly one endpoint edge A_i or D_j. Each such one-endpoint cone attaches along a cone in the middle-edge complex: at its own page only C_i, respectively B_j, remains available. Their intersections are contained in the base, so Y has zero reduced homology. The relative chains split over the ordered endpoint pairs A_i,D_j, joined to their compatible middle-edge complexes, with degree shifted up by two. For i≠j the middle complex is a cone (C_i and B_j are each the sole choice on their respective pages), so that pair contributes no homology. For i=j both middle edges on page i are forbidden; the other n−1 choices form a join of 0-spheres, so each diagonal pair contributes one line in degree n. The reduced long exact sequence identifies these relative groups equivariantly with the claimed reduced homology. A permutation sends each diagonal line to the line indexed by the image of its page. For a fixed page the orientation sign is sgn(π), coming from permuting the remaining ordered join factors. Global reversal swaps the two endpoint edges and independently reverses the 0-sphere generators on the other n−1 pages, giving (−1)^n on every diagonal line. Thus the traces hold including permutations with no fixed pages. The character determines the rational module; the Specht hook follows from sign-twisting the standard summand of the page module. The frozen blocker matching is also consistent: the two second-stage types of upward steps preserve the blocker pattern, and the unmatched residual arrows form paths V_i→T_i→U_i→C→C∪{F}.
residual_risks: The uploaded finite checks were not executed; the equivariant filtration verifies the rational claim without a finite cutoff. No equivariant collapse or wedge is inferred.

evidence: The nearest page-action result is a Dutch windmill, which glues cycles at a vertex, not an edge. For pentagons its reduced degree-n rank is 2n−1, not n. Independent blade reflection in the later wreath-product windmill result is also a different action.

Equivalently the matching complex here is the independence complex of the line graph of the edge-book, not of the book itself. The shared endpoint-edge conflict conditions are essential to the filtration calculation.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Identical page lengths and visible page symmetries do not identify the complexes or representations; the common-edge and common-vertex constructions even have different Betti numbers.

value.rationale: The book is a natural edge-glued counterpart to vertex-glued windmills and linear tilings, with page permutations and one shared reversal. The exact module distinguishes this gluing at the representation level and specifies how reversal acts, information ordinary contractions cannot supply. In particular the result uniformly explains why only same-page endpoint pairs support homology lines and why global reversal has parity n. It gives useful exact traces for every symmetry of this natural family rather than a small sample or isolated numerical Betti number.
residual_risks: No value is attributed to a general formula for other page lengths, an integral lattice, or an equivariant homotopy type.
